description: Report the product identity and release qualification status. Read-only; does not access files or external services.
name: get_status

description: Create one Git worktree under the managed root and record it. External write: creates a directory and a branch (default aw/<name>), never resets an existing branch. A repeated identical request is a no-op; any conflict refuses without overwriting.

base.description: Base ref or commit; repository HEAD when omitted.

branch.description: Existing branch to check out; mutually exclusive with detached.

detached.description: Check out base detached instead of a branch.

repo.description: Repository root or any worktree inside it.

name: create_worktree

description: List Git worktree registrations across the managed scope with ownership classification (managed, foreign, missing, orphan_candidate). Read-only. Keyset-paginated, at most 20 rows per page; orphan candidates are never automatically deletable.

discovery.description: Also scan configured discovery roots; default true.

repo.description: Restrict the scope to one repository; omit for all known repositories.

size.description: Measure on-disk size of the rows shown on this page; default false.

name: list_worktrees

description: Inspect one worktree with bounded probes: activity, integration ancestry, status counts, submodules, live processes and optional size. Read-only. Unknown, unavailable or incomplete checks are reported as such, never as clean.

checks.description: Expensive probes to run; when omitted, status, integration and processes run.

name.description: Worktree directory name; provide name or path, not both.

path.description: Absolute worktree path; provide name or path, not both.

repo.description: Repository root or any worktree inside it.

name: inspect_worktree

description: Remove one worktree. mode=preview assesses without effect and returns a fingerprint plus vetoes; mode=apply removes it under that fingerprint. Never forces and never deletes the branch; dirty, locked, protected or unverified trees are refused. An interrupted apply stays visible through the record's removal_started marker.

allow_unmerged.description: Explicitly allow removing an unmerged worktree; the branch is retained.

disposable_paths.description: Ignored paths approved for deletion, worktree-relative (for example target/).

fingerprint.description: Fingerprint returned by the preview being applied; required for apply.

mode.description: preview assesses; apply removes under the preview fingerprint.

name.description: Worktree directory name; provide name or path, not both.

path.description: Absolute worktree path; provide name or path, not both.

repo.description: Repository root or any worktree inside it.

name: remove_worktree

description: Prune stale worktree registrations for one repository. dry_run=true (the default) lists missing, unlocked registrations; dry_run=false runs native git worktree prune, which removes registrations only, never branches or existing directories.

repo.description: Repository root or any worktree inside it.

name: prune_worktrees
